title: Streaming Profile Blackmail
scenario: Someone threatens to expose viewing history unless a fee is paid.

answers.A: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.B: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.C: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.
answers.D: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.

explanation: Streaming Profile Blackmail: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Do not pay blackmail; save evidence and report.
